notes.title: Update #44 - Let's Get Physical
notes.content:
Update #44 introduces a new area, new equipment skins and ragdoll physics to the game!

The new ragdoll effects make weapons and explosions feel more impactful. Killing an enemy or setting off explosions will now enable physics simulation that will dynamically push enemies around. Shotguns just got a lot more fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/77e56c19a4efa4420f507349d50dd50efe6e751f.gif[/img]

The new construction site makes full use of the newly implemented verticality. The path leads your team deep down into the center of a giant pit. This new area features a lot of new assets and adds a new enemy type to the game! You will find the construction site right after entering the city! Make sure to restart your current run to prevent any problems!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/20fb7f6babac526efe70400600529fab0ae9d8da.jpg[/img]

Multiple new equipment skins have been added to the game. These new equipment skins can be found in the later part of the game and enable your team to look even more unique!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/8155873ffb7a24a7c9921f6cae30f85de6ed8d6d.jpg[/img]


The Full List:
[list]
[*] introduced ragdoll effects to the game
[*] improved vertical terrain support
[*] updated shooting animations to support verticality
[*] new construction site area with new assets
[*] new construction worker enemy
[*] more weapon and equipment skins
[/list]

notes.title: Update #43 - Show Me What You Got
notes.content:
[b]Update #43[/b] makes your equipment visible in the menu screen, improves game animations, improves the UI and adds a modified pistol to the game! Let's take a look!

Your collected weapons and armor are now visible in the main menu! The character on the right is holding the new modified pistol. This pistol can be found in 2nd half of the game and can shoot twice per turn!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/c185c4a7d64b36b4853822df9f58cd66ba324fb8.jpg[/img]

I'm currently working on fully integrating physics into the game! Grenades and all sorts of explosion should now impact surrounding debris. This gives explosions a little more kick!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/66ce0c94354db7f42fc50a23204622e8af28d4f2.gif[/img] 

Some UI elements like the HP, AP and Quest Marker have been tweaked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/fa94ffa26ae3d36ea6cd2fa7f9e1ad63de74a487.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update #41 - Mission Completed
notes.content:
It has been almost 2 years since we released the first version of Run For Cover on Steam. The game received over 23 updates packed with exciting new content since then. We are proud to announce that we added new enemies, abilities, areas, quests, animations and gameplay systems. Let's talk about the Highlights! 

The [b]weapon and armor system[/b] adds more tactical depth to the game. Weapons and armor feature different perks that keep the hunt for the best equipment challenging. Some perks increase the resistance to fire, some perks increase your ammunition capacity or the damage your weapon can do. The new shooting animations give every weapon a distinctive feeling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/0e6840b8e3a0718124efa17fc7b9a996d22be8e2.gif[/img]

The [b]Rebels[/b] are a AI controlled faction in the game. They enter the game at different points of the map and support the player in the fight against the enemy. They help you with soldiers and tanks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/ce90281c618c685b9cdeba10b8171436d1523a1a.gif[/img]

The Factory and City area were reworked and extended. They look really neat! We introduced the first indoor area of the game and added new enemies like the Molotov Man or the Special Forces to them. The [b]Molotov Man[/b] doesn't need a shirt to be intimidating. This enemy throws Molotov Cocktails at you to light your surroundings on fire. Burning tiles cause damage to your units and create new tactical challenges. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/ee447e6f0913365d3eb7826d03c5fca877cf0f80.gif[/img]

The Military Encampment was added to the forest area and is the highlight of the 3rd quarter of the game. This very challenging section of the map features the new Military Commander that can heal your enemies. The camp is heavily fortified and even protected by nasty [b]Proximity Mines[/b] that explode as you walk closer. Watch your step!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/7fbd2bb4ea6cf25bebee9cd0e2fb0aee390d9612.gif[/img]

[b]The Mansion[/b] was added to the game. This is the final area of the game and the location of Pablo Escobeer and his bodyguards. You have to fight your way through his last stand in order to reach the extraction point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/980a931c15503ca2b95dd4b16cb8a20651139729.jpg[/img]

We introduced a new [b]Skill Point System[/b] with Individual skill sets. We added new abilities and raised the experience cap to level 11. This will create more interesting choices along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/bb4f68f5ae69b4c6264ca6ad6ec3e3a3a77a77ec.gif[/img]

The [b]Customization System[/b] allows you to customize the name and the look of your units to your liking. You can chose from different hats, hairstyles, beards, masks and outfits. You can unlock more customization options by progressing though the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/d9288f2dceccd872fdb403f9e01cbdb93cb02cd5.gif[/img]

The game doesn't end with killing Pablo. We added [b]Difficulty Scaling[/b] and a [b]Challenge Mode[/b] to the game. You can keep your equipment and move on to a higher difficulty or try to unlock team perks that will permanently increase the stats of your units. You will need those perks, since enemies are tougher and the environment is more hazardous on higher difficulties.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/6e68c18357c33ad926f69dd2aff151cd48571f7e.gif[/img]

The updated [b]main menu[/b] lets you properly customize your experience. You can change the sound mixing, video options, hotkeys, or even the camera or animation speed to your liking.

notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/980a931c15503ca2b95dd4b16cb8a20651139729.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update #37 - Improved Interaction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/8ee1a3b24e68e7b80b77fdbbdb22ec0272ec9b13.gif[/img]

Update #37 features an improved interaction system and introduces customizable unit names. The new interaction system allows you to use a computer or open a chest directly without selecting the interaction ability first. It works pretty similar to moving your mouse over an enemy which will then automatically select your primary ability. These changes are visualized with 4 new mouse cursors. Neat stuff.  

You can now customize the name of your unit by clicking on its name in the character customization screen. The new names will be stored and displayed on the character details pages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/80e3a8f58306a06fdd43e84cf40729baedf14ca7.gif[/img]

The full list:
- unit names are customizable now
- added a hotkey R for reloading your units weapon
- deactivated the selection marker for tanks
- direct interaction without prior selection of interaction ability enabled
- new mouse cursors for attack, selection, interaction and waiting added
- loot on your movement path is highlighted


Do you like this update? What is missing? Let us know in the comments below!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917503/6e68c18357c33ad926f69dd2aff151cd48571f7e.gif[/img]

Update #34 introduces a challenge system to the game. After finishing the story on the first difficulty level, you can select additional challenges that make the game harder for you. If you manage to reach the extraction point and finish the level, the challenge will reward you with a permanent stat boost for your team. This enables you to move on to the next difficulty level where improved loot and tougher enemies wait for you. The equipment of your team and its unlocked perks can be inspected in the new team screen.

Additionally, the recent introduction of the weapon perk system made it necessary to properly display differences between weapons. A loot screen was added that enables the player to reject a found weapon when interacting with a supply chest.

[*] new perk 'Grenade Disable': attacks will prevent enemies from using grenades
[*] new perk 'Tough': adds the ability to reduce incoming damage to one

notes.title: Update #31 - Checkpoints
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34917503/35d8321627c13c037bf6fa352a354e31ba846f91.gif[/img]

This update introduces 2 checkpoints to the game. A small animation in the left corner indicates that a checkpoint was triggered and that the game just stored your progress permanently. The last checkpoint is loaded when restarting the game or by clicking 'Continue' in the main menu. You can still play without checkpoints by clicking on the 'Challenge' button in the mission selection. The challenge mode is slightly harder than the story mode now.

The full list of changes:
[list]
[*] the progress is now stored in story mode via 2 checkpoints
[*] the challenge mode is slightly harder now
[*] character customization is now stored
[*] added spawn animations to the units of the player
[*] added a slider to speed up animations
[*] added more ammunition to the rifle and pistol
[*] shortened some animations
[*] the reload icon is highlighted when the unit is out of ammunition
[/list]

notes.title: Update #30 - Reloading!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34917503/ed2bedbf7a0caf76d32ae79805335e70849b9f00.gif[/img]

This update introduces a reworked probability system and adds an ammunition and reloading mechanic to the game! These changes were designed to give the game a little more depth without slowing it down too much!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34917503/8bbfae239fb5072028439715c5620914b03bae5d.gif[/img]

This is the full list of changes in this version!
[list]
[*] added an ammunition and reloading system to the game
[*] reworked probability calculations to utilize a distance falloff
[*] added screen shake to explosions in the game
[*] added option to disable screen shake
[*] removed 'High Score' from game screen
[*] added multiple game over effects to the game
[*] added a notification when the end of the game is reached
[*] improved randomization of unit feedback
[/list]

Do you like these changes? Tell me what you think!

notes.title: Update #29 - Helpful Hints
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34917503/05e437e5bec7defc113f9e93249bc433b5988efd.gif[/img]

This update focuses on helping new players to understand the basics of the game. I added a couple of helpful hints to better explain how some of the mechanics  in the game work. These additional highlights and hints can be deactivated in the options menu. Additionally, I reworked the animation system to prevent glitches that occur when units receive multiple commands at once or when the AI deals a lot of damage to the player. The 'Destroy the Supply Truck' quest received an update and should be a little more interesting now. Attacking the truck will set off an alarm that spawns additional enemies. Unfortunately, this quest still does not offer any rewards besides experience points for your units. I hope to address that in an upcoming update. 

Fun Stuff.
[list]
[*] reworked animation system to prevent glitches
[*] reworked spawn system to support random spawn point selection
[*] deactivated ability selection during movement to prevent glitches
[*] reworked the 'Destroy the Supply Truck' quest
[*] added tutorial hint: show explosion range of barrels
[*] added tutorial hint: show heal range of units
[*] added tutorial hint: show interaction range of objects
[*] added 'Out of Range' message if targeted unit is out of range
[*] added 'General' section to the options menu
[*] added an option to deactivate tutorial hints
[/list]

notes.title: Update #28 - Weapon Abilities
notes.content:
This update is a little smaller and earlier in the week than usual but I wanted to make sure to fix a couple of issues that bugged me personally! I made the 'Guard' and 'Assault' abilities weapon specific to give the Shotgun and the Assault Rifle a very distinctive feel. I added some 'death sounds' to the enemies, it's now at least 2.5 times more fun to crush them with a tank. 

The full list of changes:
[list]
[*] The Guard ability received an increased chance to hit units in cover
[*] The Guard ability is shotgun specific now
[*] Added an ability cooldown system that recharges with kills
[*] Added an 'Assault' ability, that temporarily increases movement range
[*] Fixed a shadow issue in the office area
[*] AP display of Rebels was hidden
[*] Added death sounds to killed enemy units
[*] Added a sound when opening a chest
[*] Improved unit selection management
[/list]

What should be included in the next update or have you noticed a bug? Please let me know! Feel free to drop a review if you enjoy playing the game so far!
